name: Hiker Sorcha

intro.text: Welcome to the cliff path. It's all level, and yet I'm out of breath. That's the sea air. Or my age.

win: Fine boots. Stout heart. Come and join the walk.
after: Past the next headland is a ruin. Dunluce Castle. Legend says part of its kitchen fell into the sea in 1639. Terrible for the cook.
